Verified all 20 tickets by reading source directly in the given repo checkouts (grep for markers/call sites, then reading surrounding code to confirm each gold claim).

Overall quality is very high: 18/20 tickets pass as-is with fully accurate gold text, correct primary_paths, and (for BR tickets) caller_sets that I independently re-derived via whole-repo grep and confirmed to be complete and correct — no missed call sites, no bogus entries, in any of BR1-BR5.

One ticket has a factual error in the gold text itself (not just metadata):
- XR4 (fastapi/flask/sutra JSON serialization): gold states flask's `_default()` in json/provider.py handles "(date, uuid.UUID, dataclasses, bytes)" — I read the function directly and it does NOT handle bytes at all; it handles date, Decimal, uuid.UUID, dataclasses, and __html__-bearing objects. Everything else in this ticket (fastapi jsonable_encoder, sutra's single hard-coded isoformat() call with no generic dispatch) is accurate. Suggested fix: correct the parenthetical list in the gold text.

- NT2 (requests auth-stripping on redirect): gold's description of should_strip_auth skips over an intermediate "default port equivalence" branch that exists in the real code, but this doesn't change the correctness of the stated conclusion for the specific 8443-to-default-port scenario in the ticket.
